title: Cyclically Shift Rows and Columns
summary: In an n-by-n grid, first cyclically shift each row i left by rowShift[i] positions. Then shift each column j of that intermediate grid upward by colShift[j] positions. Return the final grid.
officialConstraints: Both shift arrays have length n; shifts are 0..n-1.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
